posts.title: Listening to Music on Apple Computers
posts.description: I purchased an 867 MHz PowerBook G4 in late 2002 or early 2003. One of the applications I immediately started using was iTunes. Using the built-in Superdrive I slowly imported more and more of my music collection. iTunes became the Music app in 2019 with the release of MacOS Catalina (10.15). posts.description: Not long after iTunes became a thing, I remember reading an article wherein the author created a playlist that consumed several other playlists, which in turn filtered tracks to be included. posts.title: Thoughts on Riding an eScooter
posts.description: I’ve owned a Niu KQi 300 P electric scooter for a little over a week now. In that time I’ve made 5 trips of increasing distance and duration. The goal is to use the scooter as alternate means of transportation back and forth to work. We live a little less than 5 miles (as the scooter rolls) from where I work.
